sources.quote: We are kicking off our public beta with a preview of a new Grok model that is currently in the final stages of development. The model – released under the provisional name grok-beta – has a context length of 128,000 tokens and also supports function calling and system prompts.
sources.supports: xAI's primary announcement confirms grok-beta was an official API preview model, but does not state its price.

notes: The available provider announcement establishes that grok-beta was an official preview model but supplies no prices. The Internet Archive CDX query for xAI pricing returned no 2025 captures (and subsequent requests failed), and the available provider pricing page no longer lists grok-beta; there is therefore no primary-source evidence here to decide whether cache_write at $15 was an official rate or models.dev's error, or to date an effective change.
